entities.summary: Albert Küchler, O.F.M., also known as Peter of Copenhagen, was a Danish painter associated with the Danish Golden Age. He mainly painted genre works and portraits. He was highly esteemed by his contemporaries but is little known today. Later in life, he converted to Catholicism and became a member of the Order of Friars Minor. Albert Küchler was a painters & sculptors from Copenhagen (1803-05-02, Copenhagen–1886-02-16). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
